§lNeoSpawn§r
§8Field Guide§r

Giant bosses, strange creatures, new ores and six hidden realms.

This guide covers the basics. EMI also has info pages: look up any NeoSpawn item.

§lContents§r

1. Ores & gear
2. Creatures
3. Eggs & hatching
4. The Easter Bunny
5. Mounts & pets
6. Realms & charms
7. Bosses
8. Gadgets & trees
9. Mob drops & ant hills

§l1. Ores§r

§4Ruby§r and §6Tanzanite§r: deep gems, like diamonds.

§8Titanium§r: very deep. Smelt the raw ore.

§2Uranium§r: glows, at the bottom of the world.

Salt and §oFossil Ore§r sit higher up.

§lGear§r

Ruby, Tanzanite and Titanium make full tool sets.

§5Paragon§r is the best: alloy Titanium, Uranium and Ruby into Paragon Ingots. Paragon tools come enchanted, and the pickaxe mines 3x3 (sneak for 1x1).

§lArmor§r

Boss scales make armor: King's Scale, Gorgantua Scale, Empress Scale. Paragon, Emerald and Experience sets too.

Wear a full set for its bonus.

§l2. Creatures§r

Over sixty wild creatures roam the overworld: dinosaurs, bugs, birds, ghosts and stranger things.

Many are friendly. Some hunt others. Some hunt you.

§l3. Dried Eggs§r

OreSpawn's namesake. Dig §oDried Eggs§r out of Fossil Ore, sift them from sand and gravel..

§lJust add water:§r drop one in water and it hatches.

§lMystery Eggs§r

A Mystery Dried Egg hatches a random creature.

A named egg ("Dried Gazelle Egg") always hatches that creature. Collect them all!

§l4. Easter Bunny§r

Look in flower forests and plains for a bunny with a §6basket of eggs§r.

Every few minutes it lays an egg: usually a §lspawn egg§r for any creature (never a boss).

§lPainted Eggs§r

Sometimes it lays a painted surprise egg instead. Crack one open:

- usually a spawn egg
- Ruby or Tanzanite
- experience
- or a rare treat

Feed it carrots for more bunnies.

§l5. Mounts§r

Tame Gazelles and Ostriches to ride. Boss eggs hatch flying Skyclaws and Azure Drakes, or a swimming Tide Dragon. Build Ant and Spider Mechs.

Mounts go where you look.

§lPets§r

§6The Royal Egg§r (from The King) hatches a pet. Feed it 8 gold, then 8 diamonds, and it grows into a rideable §lRoyal Drake§r.

Zoo Cages catch and carry mobs.

§l6. Realms§r

Six realms hide behind ants: Utopia, the Mining, Crystal, Village and Danger Realms, and the Chaos Isles.

Carry the realm's §lcharm§r and right-click its ant to travel.

§lCharms§r

Charms are never used up. Craft each one from the last realm's rewards, or find them in chests.

Right-click the ant again in a realm to come home.

§l7. Bosses§r

Bosses are rare. Each telegraphs its attacks, so watch for the warning, dodge, then strike while it recovers.

They change phase at half and quarter health.

§lSummoning§r

Build a §lSummoning Altar§r and offer the right item to call a boss. Right-click it empty-handed to see every offering.

Gold Block = §6The King§r.

§lThe King§r

A crowned wyvern of bronze and fire. It roars, breathes flame and calls lightning.

Beat it for King's Scales and the Royal Egg.

The §4Ascended King§r is worse.

§lGorgantua§r

Find 9 §lEgg Fragments§r, combine them into a Dried Gorgantua Egg, add a water bucket, then place it.

Good luck.

§lStructures§r

§6Mining:§r Mine Outposts, Excavation Sites, the Golden Spire.
§4Danger:§r Bandit Fortresses, buried Boss Arenas.
§5Crystal:§r Sanctums. §8Chaos:§r Sky Shrines.
Overworld: Ruined Crypts, Sunken Vaults.

The harder the place, the better the loot.

§l8. Gadgets§r

Squid Zooka, Ray Gun, Chainsaw, Attitude Adjuster, Instant Shelter, Ultimate Torch, XP Siphon, Sifter, repellents and more.

Check EMI for recipes.

§lTrees§r

Ore trees grow iron, gold, diamonds and more.

The §lDuplicator Tree§r's core slowly copies blocks placed beside it.

§l9. Mob drops§r

Everyday creatures leave useful parts:

§2Chitin Plate§r: bugs, ants, crabs
§5Venom Gland§r: scorpions, warbees, jellies
§bEctoplasm§r: ghosts
§eGlow Sac§r: fireflies, sprites

§lMore drops§r

§6Insect Wing§r: butterflies, moths, dragonflies
§6Dino Hide§r and the rarer §cRaptor Claw§r: dinosaurs
§2Stink Gland§r: stinkpups, stink beetles
§cKaboom Core§r: Kaboombas, Volatile Ants

§lWhat they make§r

Chitin and Dino Hide armor. Antivenom, venom arrows. Ghost Lantern, Spectral Glass. Firefly Jars, glowing arrows. Featherfall Cloak, Climbing Claws. Stink Bombs, Mining Charges.

Check EMI for recipes.

§lAnt hills§r

Coarse dirt around chitin and something of the ant's own makes an ant hill. Ants climb out until four are nearby: build a farm or an enclosure around it.

A redstone signal stops it.

§oGood luck out there.§r
